reason: I have one apartment next to my house and the guests ask the same three things: Wi-Fi, parking, where is the beach. I walk over and tell them, or my daughter writes it in a paper in the apartment, so why pay every month for this?
objection: €35 every month plus €150 is real money for me, and it solves a problem I don't really have because I am right there when guests need me.
would_change_my_mind: If it cost almost nothing, like €5 a month with no setup fee, and my daughter said it really saves her time with the guest messages.
